title: Play mode and flashcards
summary: Word Match, flashcards and why a game can be missing.
focus: Word Match, flashcard review and games that depend on course data
content:
## Games

**Play mode** holds games and one-off exercises. In this course you will find **Word Match** and **Flashcards**.

**Word Match** deals pairs of terms and meanings in rounds of five pairs. It runs against the clock. Every wrong pair costs a second. The top 10 board is shared by everyone who uses the course.

## Flashcards

Words are collected when you answer a question that teaches them. Study them as flashcards.

After each card, press **Knew it** or **Didn't know**.

- A new word is due tomorrow.
- **Knew it** on a due word moves it up a ladder: 1, 3, 7, 16, 35, 75, then 150 days.
- **Didn't know** puts it back to 1 day.

The home page shows a **Words due** card on days when words are waiting.

## Games that are missing

A game shows only when the course has the data for it. A course without a calendar has no Date Dash. A maths course has no listening game. This is normal.

quiz.explanation: Each wrong pair costs one second.
hints: It is the smallest whole number above zero.

quiz.prompt: What does Didn't know do to a word?
quiz.explanation: A miss drops the word back to a review in 1 day.
hints: The word needs another look soon.

quiz.prompt: When is a newly collected word first due?
